Traceability Index — sharecli ​

Authoritative mapping between Functional Requirements, source code, and acceptance tests. Updated by the spec+test+traceability workflow.

How to use this file:

  1. Every FR in docs/specs/FR.md has a row here.
  2. The Source column lists the canonical Rust module(s) that implement the requirement.
  3. The Tests column lists every acceptance test file that covers the requirement. Each test carries an // FR-XXX comment in its source.
  4. The Status column tracks whether the FR has at least one passing acceptance test.

Phase: 3 (spec+test+traceability e2e) Last updated: 2026-07-13 (T-230)
